Definition: Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib
BiblicalUsage: Adrammelech = "honour of the king" or "Adar is prince" or "Adar is Counsellor, Decider"; 1) an idol or god of the Sepharvites, introduced to Israel by Shalmaneser the fifth; 2) the son and murderer of Sennacherib
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
